title: @scottjenson Never forget cleansing power of your stream content washes content down Archive falls publish before proofreading push off from the dock
summary: @scottjenson Never forget cleansing power of your stream content washes content down Archive falls publish before proofreading push off from the dock faster you paddle and peddle your posts can you escape anchors of perfections #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@scottjenson Never forget cleansing power of your stream
content washes content
down Archive falls
publish before proofreading
push off from the dock
faster you paddle and peddle your posts
can you escape anchors of perfections
#smallpoems
